title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #3 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What do we say when leaving the house? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   B. Amin only
   C. Alhamdulillah only
   D. Bismillahi walajna

2. Who does the dua protect from harm? (1 mark)
   A. The one who says it, by Allah's will
   B. Only adults
   C. Nobody
   D. Only animals

3. How can children show thanks to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Compare them with others
   B. Complain
   C. Ignore them
   D. Say thank you and make dua for them

4. What did the Prophet say about being fair among children? (1 mark)
   A. Favour the eldest
   B. Favour boys
   C. Favour the youngest
   D. Fear Allah and be fair

5. What can a child do if parents are poor and cannot buy everything? (1 mark)
   A. Be patient and make dua for them
   B. Refuse to speak
   C. Complain loudly
   D. Steal

6. What does the Qur'an place right after worshipping Allah in Surah 17:23? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Trade
   C. Being kind to parents
   D. Journey

7. What does "lower the wing of humility" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Be gentle and humble to them
   B. Fly
   C. Ignore them
   D. Shout

8. Which action helps keep family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Gossiping
   B. Avoiding
   C. Visiting relatives
   D. Envy

9. What should a child do to a cousin who has more toys? (1 mark)
   A. Envy them
   B. Break them
   C. Be happy for them, not envy
   D. Take them

10. Who is a "shangazi"? (1 mark)
   A. Mother's brother
   B. Grandfather
   C. Cousin
   D. Father's sister

11. Which is a way to apply the first verses? (1 mark)
   A. Read and study daily
   B. Ignore books
   C. Skip reading
   D. Avoid school

12. In which month did the first revelation come? (1 mark)
   A. Muharram
   B. Ramadan
   C. Shawwal
   D. Rajab

13. What does "R.A." stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Read Allah
   B. Rest at once
   C. May Allah be pleased with him or her
   D. Peace be upon him

14. What does "convert" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A traveller
   B. A teacher
   C. A person who accepts a new faith
   D. A trader

15. Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet's message? (1 mark)
   A. Ali
   B. Bilal
   C. Khadija
   D. Abu Bakr

16. What does "As-Siddiq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The truthful one who believes
   B. The rich one
   C. The fast one
   D. The old one

17. Apart from Ibrahim, whose children were all the Prophet's children? (1 mark)
   A. Khadija's
   B. Aisha's
   C. Safiyya's
   D. Hafsa's

18. What is the period of Khadija's and Abu Talib's deaths called? (1 mark)
   A. The Year of Elephant
   B. The Year of Sorrow
   C. The Year of Hijrah
   D. The Year of Joy

19. Which angel came with the angel of the mountains? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Jibril
   C. Israfil
   D. Raqib

20. What should you do if you fail a test? (1 mark)
   A. Give up
   B. Study more and try again
   C. Blame others
   D. Cheat

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe what you should do when you enter your home. (4 marks)

22. Explain tawakkul using an example. (3 marks)

23. State three duties to grandparents. (3 marks)

24. Explain how a Grade 4 child can apply the command "Iqra". (4 marks)

25. Explain why parents should be fair among their children. (3 marks)

26. Draw or describe a simple family chart showing at least five relatives and their Kiswahili names. (5 marks)

27. Give three ways of thanking your parents for their care. (3 marks)

28. What warning did the Prophet give about cutting family ties? (3 marks)

29. Who were the three earliest converts studied in this lesson? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   This is the dua for leaving.

2. A — The one who says it, by Allah's will
   Allah protects.

3. D — Say thank you and make dua for them
   Gratitude.

4. D — Fear Allah and be fair
   Fairness among children.

5. A — Be patient and make dua for them
   Understand their situation.

6. C — Being kind to parents
   Kindness to parents is very important.

7. A — Be gentle and humble to them
   Be humble.

8. C — Visiting relatives
   Visits strengthen bonds.

9. C — Be happy for them, not envy
   Do not envy.

10. D — Father's sister
   Shangazi is father's sister.

11. A — Read and study daily
   Apply the command to read.

12. B — Ramadan
   The Qur'an began in Ramadan.

13. C — May Allah be pleased with him or her
   Radiyallahu anhu.

14. C — A person who accepts a new faith
   A convert changes beliefs.

15. C — Khadija
   Khadija was first.

16. A — The truthful one who believes
   Abu Bakr's title.

17. A — Khadija's
   All his children except Ibrahim were from Khadija.

18. B — The Year of Sorrow
   The Prophet lost two supporters.

19. B — Jibril
   Jibril and the angel of the mountains.

20. B — Study more and try again
   Perseverance.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah and the dua, greet with salaam, place shoes neatly, wash hands, speak kindly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four actions.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tawakkul is doing our part and then trusting Allah, for example taking an umbrella and saying the dua before leaving.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example, 1 mark for trust in Allah.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Respect and greet them, help them, visit them, listen to their stories, make dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read and study daily, ask teachers questions, use safe sources to learn, share knowledge with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four ways.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet told parents to fear Allah and be fair among children. Favouring one causes jealousy and hurt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for jealousy, 1 mark for fairness.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: babu, bibi, baba, shangazi, mjomba, binamu, each placed correctly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct relative up to 5.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, make dua for them, obey in good, help at home, behave well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: The one who cuts family ties will not enter Paradise. So we should keep ties strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the warning, 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the lesson.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Khadija, Ali and Abu Bakr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two names and 1 mark for the third.
